rule: An efficacy/normal run REJECTS if any registered name is present in its environment with a value outside inert_values ([?] entries have no inert value: presence rejects). A negative-control run must declare NEGATIVE_CONTROL=<name>; exactly the declared switch may be set and the evidence manifest records it. Default-ON levers (kind default-on-lever) carry active_values ["0"], read with the modem rule e && *e && atoi(e) == 0: any non-empty value whose C atoi() is 0 overrides them (0, 00, -0, false, off, yes); unset or empty keeps the default (tools/preflight_overrides.py lever_off, ph_fix2).
